title: Qh representative intrinsic restriction composition
statement: For every cochain complex representative P at level n, the intrinsic finite-dualizing restriction composition equation holds after applying the derived localization functor Q.

proof.text: Transport the uniquely section-normalized ordinary restriction comparison along finiteDualizingRestriction_eq. The scalar-unit map of each realized module sheaf is bijective: its underlying map is the sheafification unit of an already sheaf-valued module. Thus equality of ordinary comparison maps can be checked on these generating sections. The two paths in the composite restriction square carry each generator to the same generator, since both ordinary restriction compositors are the identity on underlying sections.

Apply the proved exact-derived-square composition theorem to the inverse ordinary restriction squares. Identify the derived ordinary fixed-scalar compositor with derivedRestrictScalarsCompIso inverse, and the derived intrinsic module compositor with normalizedDVRResComp inverse. The unique HEq characterization identifies the derived transported square with finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction. Evaluate the resulting equality on Q(P) and reverse its orientation.
